description: This file defines the class 'AccruedInterest' which contains methods for calculating accrued interest on securities, including methods for securities paying periodic interest and at maturity, with validation and utility functions.

classes.name: AccruedInterest
classes.description: Contains static methods for calculating accrued interest for securities, supporting different payment schedules and including validation.

methods.name: periodic
methods.description: Calculates the accrued interest for a security that pays periodic interest, validating input dates and values, and computing the interest based on days between issue and settlement.

methods.name: atMaturity
methods.description: Calculates the accrued interest for a security that pays interest at maturity, validating input dates and values.

methods.name: doNothing
methods.description: A private helper method that simply returns the boolean cast of its argument, effectively a placeholder.
